name: WebConfessional
source:
By applying to be an Angel for WebConfessional, you hereby swear that you 1) shall take your duty seriously and faithfully, 2) persuade the sinners to repent and atone for their sins, 3) turn them into better, conventional people to integrate them into society, and 4) shall not have your faith shaken nor misplaced by the sinners. 

If you agree to these terms, you may continue.

The sinners await your Judgement.

[From [url=https://peachieevee.itch.io/webconfessional]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
通过申请成为WebConfessional的天使，你在此宣誓：1）认真忠实地履行你的职责，2）说服罪人悔改并赎罪，3）将他们变成更好的，传统的人，融入社会，4）不会让你的信仰被罪人动摇或迷失。

如果你同意这些条款，你可以继续。

罪人等待着你的审判。

[来自[url=https://peachieevee.itch.io/webconfessional]itch.io[/url]]
